1479-2841-6926-8337.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-6926-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

7084-7396-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-7396-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Repeat.

2174-2645-3430-6256.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2174-2645-3430-6256.description:
Activate Muraganda Raceway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Muraganda Raceway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2292-5254-7741.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2292-5254-7741.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

1231-4826-6495-6644.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
1231-4826-6495-6644.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7155.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4186-5231-6566--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

1308-6441-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2136-2178-4826-7898.easyPrerequisites: Opponents control two or more artifacts.
2136-2178-4826-7898.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Smaug.
Put the Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token's first ability triggers, creating a number of Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.
2136-2178-4826-7898.notes: If opponents control exactly two artifacts, you can still get infinite Treasures by using Orthion's second ability instead. If opponents control three or more, either ability will net infinite Treasures.

215-6478-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-6478-7297.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4289-5223-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4289-5223-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4289-5223-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

4499-4785-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

997-7124-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
997-7124-7357.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

1171-1409-7175.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

628-5686-7219.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

546-4613-5900-7235.easyPrerequisites: There are at least six total creatures on the battlefield.
546-4613-5900-7235.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Stag Beetle. Stag Beetle enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Stag Beetle using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

874-1170-1329-2079.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-2079.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3259-6438-6968.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6438-6968.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1978-3053-3301.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1978-3053-3301.description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

2854-4574-4708-6900.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-4574-4708-6900.description:
Cast Dark Sphere either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1003-5220-6798-6900.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1231-4826-6644-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2850-6797--71.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1308-1879-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

4493-5226-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
You have enough mana to cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication
4493-5226-5365.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 2.
4493-5226-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

4369-4613-4968.notablePrerequisites: The Red Terror has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4369-4613-4968.description:
Activate The Red Terror using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2201-2558-4659-5687.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Repeat.

1750-1979-4084-5261.notablePrerequisites: Efreet Flamepainter does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1750-1979-4084-5261.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Efreet Flamepainter.
Efreet Flamepainter triggers, causing you to cast Part the Waterveil from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Part the Waterveil, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Part the Waterveil from exile into your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2777-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Driver of the Dead in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
2034-2777-5326.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Master, adding {C}{C}.
When The Master dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Repeat.

129-2544-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Kinnan's ability.

2190-2390-3372.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to place a counter on a permanent or player.
2190-2390-3372.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing All Will Be One to become an enchantment creature.
Place a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Vraska triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on All Will Be One.
Repeat from step 3.

1030-2034-4730.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-2034-4730.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sparring Mummy, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.

539-4657-5234.easyPrerequisites: You control two mana-producing lands other than Magus of the Candelabra.
539-4657-5234.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers twice, adding {2}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

224-907-1257.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.
